```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, error = TRUE)
B <- readRDS(params$bundle)
library(DT); library(plotly); library(htmltools)
# One table style for the whole stage set, matching the run report's QC table:
# compact, striped, sortable, no paging. DT >= 0.34 rejects callback = NULL, so a
# no-op JS keeps the argument type valid (this broke the run report under --lite).
tbl <- function(d, order_col = NULL, digits = NULL) {
  if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) return(HTML("<p class='none'>Not available for this run.</p>"))
  o <- list(dom = "t", paging = FALSE, ordering = TRUE, scrollX = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(order_col)) o$order <- list(list(order_col, "asc"))
  x <- datatable(d, rownames = FALSE, class = "compact stripe hover", selection = "none",
                 callback = DT::JS("return table;"), options = o)
  if (!is.null(digits)) for (cc in intersect(digits, names(d))) x <- formatRound(x, cc, 2)
  x
}
img <- function(u, alt = "") if (is.null(u)) HTML("<p class='none'>Figure unavailable.</p>") else
  HTML(sprintf("<img src='%s' alt='%s' style='width:100%%;height:auto;border-radius:6px'>",
               u, htmlEscape(alt)))
grid <- function(lst, nm = names(lst), cap = NULL) {
  keep <- !vapply(lst, is.null, logical(1))
  if (!any(keep)) return(HTML("<p class='none'>No panels available.</p>"))
  HTML(paste0("<div class='pgrid'>", paste0(
    "<figure><img src='", unlist(lst[keep]), "' alt='", htmlEscape(nm[keep]),
    "'><figcaption>", htmlEscape(nm[keep]), "</figcaption></figure>",
    collapse = ""), "</div>"))
}
```

```{css echo=FALSE}
body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
     color:#222;max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px 60px;line-height:1.55}
h1{font-size:1.75em;margin:1.1em 0 .15em;border-bottom:2px solid #eee;padding-bottom:.3em}
h2{font-size:1.2em;margin:1.7em 0 .35em;color:#1a4f7a}
.meta{font-size:.85em;color:#666;margin:0 0 1.4em}
.lead{background:#f4f8fb;border-left:4px solid #1a4f7a;padding:11px 15px;margin:1em 0;
      border-radius:0 4px 4px 0}
.lead p{margin:.25em 0}
.note{font-size:.9em;color:#555;background:#fcfcfa;border:1px solid #ededed;
      padding:10px 14px;border-radius:4px;margin:.9em 0}
.none{color:#888;font-style:italic;font-size:.92em}
.pgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(290px,1fr));gap:14px;margin:1em 0}

.pgrid figcaption{font-size:.84em;color:#555;text-align:center;margin-top:4px;font-weight:600}

     padding:9px 18px;margin:1em 0}
```

```{r head, results="asis"}
cat(sprintf("<p class='meta'>%s · stage %s · generated %s</p>",
            htmlEscape(B$.run), B$.id, B$.generated))
cat(sprintf("<div class='lead'><p>%s</p></div>", htmlEscape(B$.blurb)))
```

```{r stage01, eval=(B$.id=="01"), results="asis"}
cat("## Distribution of cell quality metrics\n\n")
cat("<div class='note'>One violin per sample. Genes and UMIs per cell in the low thousands",
    "indicate healthy, well-captured cells. A sample whose mitochondrial fraction sits",
    "visibly higher than the others had more stressed or dying cells.</div>\n")
print(img(B$violin, "QC violins per sample"))
cat("\n\n## Every cell, UMIs against genes\n\n")
cat("<div class='note'>Shared axes across samples so panels compare directly; colour is",
    "mitochondrial percentage. Healthy cells form one dense diagonal cloud. A separate",
    "cloud low on both axes is debris or empty droplets.</div>\n")
print(grid(B$qc_panels))
cat("\n\n## What each filter removed\n\n")
t <- B$thresholds
cat(sprintf("<div class='note'>Cells were kept with at least %s genes%s%s.</div>\n",
  format(t$min_features, big.mark = ","),
  if (!is.na(t$max_features)) sprintf(" and at most %s", format(t$max_features, big.mark = ",")) else "",
  if (!is.na(t$max_mt)) sprintf(", and below %s%% mitochondrial reads", t$max_mt) else ""))
```

```{r stage03, eval=(B$.id=="03"), results="asis"}
P <- B$per_sample
cat("## Per-sample clustering\n\n")
cat("<div class='note'>Each sample clustered independently, coloured by its own cluster",
    "numbering. Cluster numbers are not comparable between samples — only the integrated",
    "analysis gives labels that mean the same thing across samples.</div>\n")
print(grid(lapply(P, `[[`, "panel"), names(P)))
cat("\n\n## Clusters and top markers per sample\n\n")
rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(P), function(s) {
  x <- P[[s]]
  if (is.null(x$top) || !nrow(x$top)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(Sample = s, Cluster = x$top$Cluster,
             `Top markers` = x$top$`Top markers`, check.names = FALSE)
}))
```

```{r stage03_t, eval=(B$.id=="03")}
tagList(tbl(rows))
```

```{r stage05_umap, eval=(B$.id=="05")}
rx <- B$range$x; ry <- B$range$y
cen <- B$centroids
plot_ly() |>
  add_trace(data = cen, x = ~u1, y = ~u2, type = "scatter", mode = "markers+text",
            text = ~ct, textposition = "top center",
            textfont = list(size = 11, color = "#111"),
            marker = list(size = 9, color = "rgba(255,255,255,.85)",
                          line = list(width = 1.5, color = "#333")),
            hoverinfo = "text",
            hovertext = ~sprintf("%s<br>%s cells", ct, format(n, big.mark = ",")),
            showlegend = FALSE, name = "") |>
  layout(images = list(list(source = B$umap_ct, xref = "x", yref = "y",
                            x = rx[1], y = ry[2], sizex = diff(rx), sizey = diff(ry),
                            sizing = "stretch", layer = "below")),
         xaxis = list(range = rx, showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE,
                      showticklabels = FALSE, title = ""),
         yaxis = list(range = ry, showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE,
                      showticklabels = FALSE, title = "", scaleanchor = "x"),
         margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 8, b = 0), plot_bgcolor = "white",
         height = 520) |>
  config(displaylogo = FALSE)
```

```{r stage05_prop, eval=(B$.id=="05")}
d <- B$counts
plot_ly(d, x = ~sample, y = ~pct, color = ~cell_type, colors = B$pal, type = "bar",
        hoverinfo = "text",
        hovertext = ~sprintf("%s<br>%s: %.1f%%<br>%s cells", sample, cell_type, pct,
                             format(n, big.mark = ","))) |>
  layout(barmode = "stack", xaxis = list(title = ""),
         yaxis = list(title = "% of sample", range = c(0, 100)),
         legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2), margin = list(t = 8)) |>
  config(displaylogo = FALSE)
```

```{r stage05_mk_t, eval=(B$.id=="05" && !is.null(B$markers))}
m <- B$markers
sc <- intersect(c("avg_log2FC", "avg_logFC"), names(m))
cl <- intersect(c("cluster"), names(m))
if (length(sc) && length(cl)) {
  m <- m[order(m[[cl]], -m[[sc[1]]]), ]
  m <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(m, m[[cl]]), head, 10))
  rownames(m) <- NULL
}
tagList(tbl(utils::head(m, 400)))
```
